description_expanded: Description Description Experience the ultimate Gulf Coast getaway at Sea La Vie, a stunning Cottages at Eastern Lake beach house rental in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach. Perfectly designed for large groups, this luxury 30A retreat features deeded beach access just a short stroll or golf cart ride away, putting the sugar-white sands and emerald waters of the Florida Panhandle right at your doorstep. Managed by Panhandle Getaways, this 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home combines coastal elegance with unrivaled convenience. Your stay includes a 6-passenger street-legal golf cart and 4 custom cruiser bikes, making it effortless to explore the boutiques and dining of 30A. PROPERTY AMENITIES & FEATURES• Prime 30A Location: Nestled in the tranquil Cottages at Eastern Lake community.• Complimentary Transportation: Street-legal Golf Cart and 4 Bikes included.• Spacious Living Area: Open-concept layout with a 65" Smart TV for family movie nights.• Gourmet Kitchen: Fully equipped with a breakfast bar, high-end appliances, and a full dining area.• High-Speed Wi-Fi: Stay connected with complimentary high-speed internet.• Laundry Room: Full-size washer and dryer provided.• Total Capacity: Comfortably Sleeps 12 guests. BEDROOM CONFIGURATION• Master Suite 1: King Bed, 55" TV, Private En Suite Bathroom• Master Suite 2: King Bed, 55" TV, Private En Suite Bathroom• Guest Suite 3: Queen Bed, 55" TV, Private En Suite Bathroom• Guest Bedroom 4: Queen Bed, 55" TV• Bunk Room 5: Two Sets of Bunk Beds (Twin over Twin), 55" TV — Perfect for kids! Security Note: To ensure guest safety, this property is equipped with 6 exterior surveillance devices at entry points and the home perimeter. THE XPLORIE ADVANTAGE: FREE LOCAL ATTRACTIONSAs a guest of Panhandle Getaways, you’ll receive our exclusive Xplorie Activity Pass. Enjoy one free daily admission to some of the most popular 30A attractions (available for stays up to 27 days):• Daily Golf: One free round of golf at one of four premier local courses.• Dolphin & Snorkel Tours: One free voucher per day for unforgettable Gulf excursions (Mar–Oct).• Bike Rentals: Your 4 included bikes are ready at the home year-round. ABOUT THE COTTAGES AT EASTERN LAKE COMMUNITYThe Cottages at Eastern Lake offers an idyllic blend of coastal nature and resort luxury. Located near the rare coastal dune waters of Eastern Lake, this neighborhood provides a peaceful sanctuary for kayaking, paddleboarding, and nature walks. Community Highlights:• Resort-Style Pool: Large community pool with plenty of seating for sunbathing.• Deeded Beach Access: Seamless access to the Gulf of Mexico.• Shaded Retreat: A "Natural Preserve" atmosphere with lush greenery and canopy shade. 30A Beach Access Points GUEST ESSENTIALS & INITIAL SUPPLIESTo ensure a stress-free arrival, we provide an initial "Starter Kit." While these are not restocked during your stay, they cover your needs until your first grocery run:• Kitchen: Paper towels, dishwasher soap, and trash bags.• Laundry: Initial supply of washing machine powder.• Bathrooms: Hotel-style shampoo, conditioner, and bar soap (one set per bathroom), plus one roll of toilet paper per bathroom.• Linens: All premium bed linens and bath towels are provided. Note: We recommend bringing your own beach towels for use at the resort pool and beach access points. Ready to start your Santa Rosa Beach adventure? Book Sea La Vie with Panhandle Getaways today!
